pages.title: Popups
pages.text:
Point at a name to see it; press it to pin the window, then drag it round or zoom it.

- {entity:minecraft:blaze}, from the tag {entity:...}
- [An allay](entity:minecraft:allay), from a link
- [The igloo](structure:minecraft:igloo/top), a structure
- [The watchtower](build:watchtower), a build file
- [The hut](multiblock:world/builds#hut), a multiblock page

A mod's own kind of link: [say hello](say:Hello from the book!).
